tasks.goal: How long is an on-call rotation, and who approves swaps?

documents.title: On-call handbook
documents.body: Each on-call rotation lasts nine days. Swaps are approved by the duty manager. Pages must be acknowledged within twelve minutes.

documents.title: Holiday calendar
documents.body: The office closes for two days in late December.

documents.body: The billing service stores invoices in a CockroachDB cluster.

documents.title: Service ownership list
